title: Google Plans Up To $40 Billion Investment In Anthropic
key_facts: Google will invest up to $40 billion in Anthropic: $10 billion in cash up front at a $350 billion valuation and $30 billion more if Anthropic meets performance targets.
Anthropic would secure 5 gigawatts of computing capacity from Google.
Amazon had days earlier committed $5 billion, with up to $20 billion more, and Anthropic promised more than $100 billion of spending on Amazon Web Services over 10 years.
The article says Anthropic has commitments for 10 gigawatts across the Google and Amazon deals.
It mentions a possible IPO 'as early as October' and valuations of $800 billion or more reported by Bloomberg.
The article is undated in its text ('on Friday', 'on Monday') and its $350 billion valuation is far below the $965 billion Business Insider says Anthropic reached in May.
quote_evidence: Google committed $10 billion in cash on Friday at a $350 billion valuation.
The Alphabet-owned company will invest another $30 billion if Anthropic hits performance targets.
why_it_matters_hint: Shows how the biggest tech groups are tying themselves to Anthropic with money and computing power.
event_date: not stated; appears to be an earlier 2026 deal
notes: Page carries no date. Valuation and 'IPO as early as October' wording suggest it was written well before 14 Oct 2026; likely re-dated by the Google News listing. Not verified against a second outlet.
